C_sensed.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; owner's hand-set value in the SN_simple model (CA token 'user_defined'); filter capacitance of the sensed-voltage (electrode) stage, not a physiological quantity

d.data_reference: definitional; soma diameter of the sphere of the model volume: d = (Vol/k_V)^(1/3) = (6 Vol/pi)^(1/3) with Vol = 7,500 um^3, the previous volume parameter (wallis1996cardiac; rat stellate soma, mean projected area ~463 um^2; 7,500 um^3 the owner's choice on review, see SN_Na_K_concentrations_soma)

k_A.data_reference: definitional; area shape factor A = k_A d^2, chosen to reproduce the previous Cm: A = Cm/c_m = 30 pF (the previous Cm, hong2021macrophage: rat stellate ganglion whole-cell capacitance 33-36 pF) / (0.01 pF/um^2) = 3,000 um^2, so k_A = A/d^2 = 5.086. It is larger than a sphere's pi because the area includes membrane beyond the soma sphere (dendrites)

k_V.data_reference: definitional; volume shape factor V = k_V d^3 of a sphere, pi/6 (to double precision; the last bit is chosen so that Vol reproduces the previous value where a float allows)

c_m.data_reference: gentet2000direct; specific membrane capacitance 0.9 uF/cm^2 measured directly in nucleated patches of cortical pyramidal, spinal cord and hippocampal neurons (Abstract); 1 uF/cm^2 (0.01 pF/um^2) is the conventional value used here

I_in.data_reference: definitional; injected current (positive depolarises); 0 = no stimulus

I_out.data_reference: definitional; axial current to the axon, supplied in a network; 0 for the isolated soma

R_diffSensed.data_reference: unreferenced_placeholder; owner's hand-set value in the SN_simple model (CA token 'user_defined'); filter resistance of the sensed-voltage (electrode) stage, not a physiological quantity

V_rest_approx.data_reference: davis2020downregulation; resting membrane potential of rat stellate neurons: Wistar -72.6 +- 1.0 mV (Fig. 4C), SHR -70.3 +- 1.4 mV (Fig. 5D); -70 mV approximates it (the CA token cites davis2021transcriptomic, whose current-clamp traces the value was read from)
